with fresh as (
  select date_trunc('hour', c."taken_at"::timestamptz) as "bucket", c."org_id" as "org_id", c."kind" as "kind", count(*) as "events", sum(c."watts") as "watts_sum", max(c."watts") as "watts_max", sum(c."cost") as "cost_sum"
  from public.readings as c
  where c."taken_at" >= date_trunc('hour', $1) and c."deleted_at" is null
  group by 1, 2, 3
), gone as (
  delete from "public"."readings_hourly" as r where r."bucket" >= date_trunc('hour', $1) and not exists (select from fresh where fresh."bucket" = r."bucket" and fresh."org_id" = r."org_id" and fresh."kind" = r."kind")
)
insert into "public"."readings_hourly" ("bucket", "org_id", "kind", "events", "watts_sum", "watts_max", "cost_sum")
select "bucket", "org_id", "kind", "events", "watts_sum", "watts_max", "cost_sum" from fresh
on conflict ("bucket", "org_id", "kind") do update set "events" = excluded."events", "watts_sum" = excluded."watts_sum", "watts_max" = excluded."watts_max", "cost_sum" = excluded."cost_sum"
